import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int N = 10005;
    static final int S = N - 2;
    static final int T = N - 1;
    static final int M = 2000010;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;

    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] nxt = new int[M];
    static int[] capacity = new int[M];
    static int[] cost = new int[M];
    static int edgeIdx = 1;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        to[++edgeIdx] = v;
        nxt[edgeIdx] = head[u];
        head[u] = edgeIdx;
        capacity[edgeIdx] = cap;
        cost[edgeIdx] = cst;

        to[++edgeIdx] = u;
        nxt[edgeIdx] = head[v];
        head[v] = edgeIdx;
        capacity[edgeIdx] = 0;
        cost[edgeIdx] = -cst;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int[] dist, boolean[] inQ) {
        Arrays.fill(inQ, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0x3f3f3f3f);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(T);
        dist[T] = 0;
        inQ[T] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            inQ[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                int y = to[i];
                if (capacity[i ^ 1] > 0 && dist[y] > dist[x] + cost[i ^ 1]) {
                    dist[y] = dist[x] + cost[i ^ 1];
                    if (!inQ[y]) {
                        q.offer(y);
                        inQ[y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[S] < 0x3f3f3f3f;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int flowLimit, long[] totalCost, int[] capacity, int[] cost, int[] to, int[] nxt, int[] head, boolean[] inQ, int[] dist) {
        int flow = 0;
        inQ[x] = true;
        if (x == T) return flowLimit;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = to[i];
            if (capacity[i] == 0 || inQ[y]) continue;
            if (dist[x] != dist[y] + cost[i]) continue;
            int t = dfs(y, Math.min(capacity[i], flowLimit - flow), totalCost, capacity, cost, to, nxt, head, inQ, dist);
            capacity[i] -= t;
            capacity[i ^ 1] += t;
            flow += t;
            totalCost[0] += (long) t * cost[i];
            if (flow == flowLimit) break;
        }
        inQ[x] = false;
        return flow;
    }

    static long minCostFlow(int n, int m, int k, int c, int d, int[] xArr, int[] yArr) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        long totalCost = 0;
        int[] dist = new int[N];
        boolean[] inQ = new boolean[N];

        // Initialize graph
        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        edgeIdx = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = xArr[i] - 1;
            addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
        }
        int limit = 101;
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n, T, k, c * i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < limit - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * n, i + (j + 1) * n, k, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int idx = 0; idx < m; idx++) {
            int x = xArr[idx] - 1;
            int y = yArr[idx] - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < limit - 1; i++) {
                for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                    addEdge(x + i * n, y + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                    addEdge(y + i * n, x + (i + 1) * n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(inQ, false);
            if (!spfa(dist, inQ)) break;
            int flow = dfs(S, 101, new long[]{totalCost}, capacity, cost, to, nxt, head, inQ, dist);
            totalFlow += flow;
            totalCost += (long) flow * 0; // totalCost updated inside dfs
        }
        return totalCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int[] xArr = new int[k];
        int[] yArr = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            xArr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            yArr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        long result = minCostFlow(n, m, k, c, d, xArr, yArr);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
